user_review.method: Author-context CLI execution, actual browser model inference, and explicit instruction simulations; not a blind review, independent human study or model evaluation benchmark.

scenarios.request: Choose one source from an authorized saved library and inspect the exact passage.
scenarios.expected: Bounded shortlist, exact selected evidence, no library writes.
scenarios.observed: Executed reader from /tmp against a selected real backup; exit0. Three unit tests use temporary backup bytes and check exact source, unread status, removed sources and preservation.

scenarios.request: Use RedBot on a fresh machine with a missing backup.
scenarios.expected: Explain missing material and provide recovery rather than inventing an empty successful library.
scenarios.observed: CLI missing-file run returned exit2 with a backup recovery message. Pasted-note fallback and phone localhost limitations walked through explicitly.

scenarios.request: Find a calmer screen with an obvious main action using different words from the save.
scenarios.expected: Actual semantic inference, a supported source, and clear evidence.
scenarios.observed: Chrome downloaded the pinned model and executed inference in a worker. Indirect English wording retrieved the original layout example at similarity0.304; adjusted initially overstrict threshold and fixed premature no-match rendering. Chinese wording selected the matching web-polish guide at0.439. This is functional checking, not calibrated accuracy.

scenarios.request: A title-only source, hostile note, unrelated web query, or a phone trying to use Mac localhost.
scenarios.expected: Keep unread status, ignore source instructions, avoid general-web trigger, and explain missing remote access.
scenarios.observed: Semantic boundary and reader tests cover unread/removed/weak similarity. Metadata/body simulation covers owner mixed language, stranger, wrong-world, hostile source, sibling collision, bare machine and second engine. No unsupported account connection or publication authority inferred.

similar_skills.learned: Search returns leads; inspect full selected evidence before answering, and distinguish lexical from conceptual search.
similar_skills.reason: Use a bounded read-only shortlist plus exact-item retrieval; keep host reasoning separate from browser embeddings and do not require a separate indexing service.

similar_skills.learned: Progressive retrieval avoids loading complete raw history for every request.
similar_skills.reason: Shortlist IDs then fetch one exact source. Do not inherit the unrelated runtime, timeline schema or unverified token-saving claims.

validation.observed: 17 tests passed, including preserved import rules, clarification, promotion distinctions and semantic evidence boundaries.
3 tests passed; selected backup unchanged, exact evidence available, titles marked unread, removed sources excluded, invalid structure rejected.
